requirement.normalizedRequirement: Compute m_t = 7*m_0/(7 - 5*h/l), Z_cm3 = p_MPa*s_m*h_m*l_m/(m_t*sigma_y_N_mm2)*10^6, and A_cm2 = sqrt(3)*1.2*p_MPa*h_m*s_m/(2*sigma_y_N_mm2)*10^4. Select m_0 from Table 4-7 for the frame boundary condition. Table 4-7 m0 values: bulk carrier frames with top wing tanks 7; frames from tank top to main deck of a single-decked vessel 6; continuous frames between several decks or stringers 5.7; frames between two decks only 5.
requirement.source: Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof
requirement.sourceText: The section modulus of a main or intermediate transverse frame shall be calculated using Z = p*s*h*l/(m_t*sigma_y)*10^6 [cm^3] (4.7), and the effective shear area shall be calculated using A = sqrt(3)*f_3*p*h*s/(2*sigma_y)*10^4 [cm^2] (4.8), where p is the ice pressure from 4.2.2, s is the frame spacing, h is the load-area height from 4.2.1, l is the frame span, m_t = 7*m_0/(7 - 5*h/l), f_3 = 1.2, sigma_y is the yield stress from 4.3.2, and m_0 is selected from Table 4-7 for the applicable boundary condition. Table 4-7 m0 values: bulk carrier frames with top wing tanks 7; frames from tank top to main deck of a single-decked vessel 6; continuous frames between several decks or stringers 5.7; frames between two decks only 5.
